purpose: Teach: ぶろ/リーチ/ジーニョ/レナ/ヤス/キラー/ドタバタ/バーン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ぶろの世界は厳しい」って語って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying how the pro world is really tough.
lines.style: Warm, almost wistful observation. Gentle pace. Soft emphasis on what Ryosuke said, as if she's treasuring the moment he's spending with Sho. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと麻雀のリーチのルール覚えたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me the rules for reaching in mahjong!
lines.style: Bright, proud excitement. Quick pace, words tumbling over each other. Open, unguarded — the joy of having Dad's attention. Small laugh of delight underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがロナウジーニョの伝説のゴール集を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's watching a compilation of Ronaldinho's legendary goals.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly amused observation. Moderate pace. Quiet fondness — she notices what Ryosuke chooses to do, what he shares with their son. A private smile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとレナちゃん、つまりおいとこに遊んでもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and Cousin Lena played with me today!
lines.style: Cheerful, almost breathless with the news. Bouncy pace. The weight of inclusion — being played with by the adults matters. Genuine delight that it happened.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ヤスい服でも工夫次第」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was saying you can make any outfit work if you're creative about it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently encouraging tone. Measured pace. She's noting Ryosuke's practical kindness — the way he teaches without lecturing. Quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサッカーのキラーパス集の動画観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a video of killer passes in soccer!
lines.style: Energetic, eager to share. Quick tempo. Unself-conscious enthusiasm — he's reliving the moment with Dad, wanting her to know. Bright and open.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがドタバタコメディの映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad's watching a slapstick comedy movie.
lines.style: Soft amusement in the voice. Easy, unhurried pace. She's noticing Ryosuke's playfulness, his willingness to be silly. Contentment in the observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと花火の「バーン」って音を一緒に聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I listened to the bang of the fireworks together!
lines.style: Pure, unguarded joy. Warm, lingering pace — stretching the memory out. The wonder in his voice of sharing a sensory moment with Dad. Soft, full heart.
